description: Adaptive practice system evaluating quantitative financial modeling, product validation, unit economics, data ethics, and algorithmic operational logic.

stages.desc_en: Stratified cross-topic sampling to detect knowledge blind spots and baseline accuracy.
stages.desc_zh: 跨模块分层抽样摸底，测出初始知识长短板与基线正确率。

stages.desc_en: Targeted domain drills with bilingual stems and in-depth distractor reasoning.
stages.desc_zh: 按知识模块专项突破，结合双语解析与错因剖析吃透考点。

stages.desc_en: Bayesian-smoothed review targeting historical misconceptions until 100% resolved.
stages.desc_zh: 错题本贝叶斯加权攻坚，消灭易混淆项直到完全掌握。

stages.desc_en: Strict timed mock exam without answer leakage; full scorecard and review upon submission.
stages.desc_zh: 严格倒计时全真模考，答题中不泄露答案，交卷后统一生成成绩单与考后复盘。

stages.desc_en: Tailored adaptive test sets balancing weak domains, unattempted items, and spaced review.
stages.desc_zh: 自适应个性化套卷，针对薄弱点靶向攻坚，冲刺达标认证。
